title: A Family and Country Are in Crisis in ‘Our Share of Sand’ (Exclusive Venice Clip)
summary: Newcomer Maya Mehta stars opposite Mohammad Zeeshan Ayyub in the debut feature from writer-director Shalini Adnani, which has its world premiere in Venice Critics' Week.

title: Robert Pattinson’s Banner Year Ticks on as He’s Named Jaeger-LeCoultre Global Ambassador
summary: The role is a natural progression for the London-born Pattinson who is said to be a "genuine admirer" of fine watchmaking and mechanical timepieces: "There's an integrity to everything they create."

title: Brad Bird’s ‘Ray Gunn,’ Travis Knight’s ‘Wildwood’ Among BFI London Film Fest World Premieres
summary: Fest circuit highlights, such as 'Artificial,' 'Ink,' 'Wild Horse Nine' and 'Club Kid,' also join the 70th edition of the fest, as is the series 'The Trip to the Northern Lights' with Rob Brydon and Steve Coogan.

title: Siri Hustvedt Enters the World of Witches and Peter Zumthor in ‘From Inside Out’ (Exclusive Trailer)
summary: Wim Wenders' Venice-bound documentary explores the world of the award-winning Swiss architect.

title: Disney+ Sets Release Date for Ji Chang-wook and Mio Imada Rom-Com Series ‘Merry Berry Love’
summary: The show was developed and produced by Korean giant CJ ENM, Disney and co-produced by Japan's Nippon TV.

title: ‘Onwards and Sideways’ Trailer: Laura Linney and Rhys Ifans Are a Duo Diagnosed With Parkinson’s
summary: The Toronto-bowing movie, directed by John Madden based on a Paul Mayhew-Archer script, also features Monica Dolan and Rory Kinnear.

title: ‘The Indies’ Goes on a Journey With 3 Men Taking a Painting Across a Europe Ravaged by Conflicts (Exclusive Venice Trailer)
summary: The period road movie, the debut fiction feature from Pauline Julier and Nicolas Chapoulier, premieres in the Venice Days program, using a historical lens to examine the origins of the world we inhabit today.

title: Venice First Look: Toni Servillo Meets His Match in Mario Martone’s ‘Scherzetto’
summary: The Italian screen legend plays a solitary illustrator thrown into battle with his unruly five-year-old grandson in the feature adaptation of Domenico Starnone’s novel.

title: Julianne Moore to Receive Zurich Film Festival’s Golden Icon Award
summary: The U.S. actress will be joined by Jesse Eisenberg, who directs her in his latest film 'The Debut,' at a ceremony in Zurich, Switzerland.

title: Bill Simmons Says “I Learned My Lesson” After Admitting to Proxy Betting on Fanduel in Podcast Interview
summary: Fanduel says it reported the bets to Massachusetts gaming authorities, with Simmons telling his podcast listeners Tuesday that he made a mistake.
